product.title: Aveeno Baby Soothing Relief Emollient Wash 250m
product.description:
Aveeno Baby Soothing Relief Emollient Wash 250ml is a gentle cleansing wash specially formulated for babies with dry and sensitive skin. Its soothing formula helps cleanse the skin without leaving it feeling excessively dry or tight. It is ideal for use during your baby's daily bath routine and helps keep delicate skin feeling soft, comfortable, and moisturized.

Key Benefits

  • Gently cleanses delicate baby skin

  • Helps soothe dry and sensitive skin

  • Helps maintain the skin's natural moisture

  • Leaves skin feeling soft and comfortable

  • Suitable for everyday bathing

  • Ideal for babies with dry, sensitive skin

How to Use

Apply a small amount to wet skin during bath time. Gently massage over the baby's body, then rinse thoroughly with clean water. Pat the skin dry gently with a soft towel. For best results, follow with a suitable baby moisturizer or emollient cream.

Suitable For

Babies and children with dry or sensitive skin.
